blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.
blocks.zh: 世界模型为基于物理学的模拟器提供了一种有希望的替代方法,但仍然远远没有实际应用。 我们问他们用30,000小时的数据集 覆盖了1000多个场景类型和14,000个贡献者。 我们没有依赖不透明的下游衡量标准,而是直接根据具有挑战性的分配外基准来评估代理人和对象之间的忠诚。 增加100x的训练数据既能改善两者,又能改善不均:物剂的模型造型良好,而物体的忠诚度仍然很低,而且改善缓慢. 我们显示,剂的增益不需要来自数据, 一个细心的视觉调节设计 与它的一小部分是饱和的, 它让我们可以测量物体的纯度 并发现它的饱和点。 然后我们引入一个监督计划,将容量从场景外观转向物体动力学,提高物体的忠诚度,尽管仍然存在很大的差距。 最后,我们的结论转移到下游人造物模型。 总体而言,我们的结果表明,以自我为中心的规模化数据使模拟代理人接近其极限,同时将其对世界的影响远远落在后面,缩小这一差距将取决于模型是如何训练的,而不仅仅取决于它们看到多少数据。

Right: The same failure at the level of a single prediction. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models ( Schmidhuber, 1990 ) are being pursued for two distinct roles in embodied AI. As simulators, they promise to replace hand-authored environments for training and evaluating policies at scale, where relying on the physical world alone is prohibitively costly, slow, and unsafe ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . As predictive models for planning, they promise to let an agent evaluate candidate actions at inference time by rolling out their consequences ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Bar et al., 2025 ) . Both roles rest on the same capability: predicting how the objects an agent interacts with respond to its actions. This is precisely where conventional physics-based simulators fall short: contact, friction and deformation resist accurate simulation even when contact parameters are fit to real-world data ( Acosta et al., 2022 ; Blanco-Mulero et al., 2024 ) . World models offer to learn these phenomena directly from data, if they in fact acquire them.
blocks.zh: 正在寻求世界模式(Schmidhuber,1990年),以体现大赦国际的两个不同角色。 作为模拟者,他们承诺将大规模地取代手写环境,用于培训和评价政策,因为仅依靠物理世界是代价高昂、缓慢和不安全的(Guo等,2026;Gao等,2026)。 作为规划的预测模型,他们承诺让一名代理人通过推展其后果来推断候选人的行动(Ha和Schmidhuber,2018;Bar等,2025)。 两种角色都依赖于相同的能力: 预测一个代理对象如何与其行动反应互动. 这恰恰是常规物理模拟器不足的地方:接触,摩擦和变形即使在接触参数适合现实世界数据时也抵抗准确的模拟(Acosta等,2022;Blanco-Mulero等,2024.). 世界模型提供直接从数据中学习这些现象,如果它们事实上得到它们的话。

blocks.en: Recent efforts have scaled world models to large and diverse datasets of human–object interaction ( Punamiya et al., 2026 ) , in some cases comprising decades of interaction-dense footage ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Dyna Robotics, 2026 ) . Consistent gains with more data and larger models have encouraged a scaling-centric view: that dataset and model size are all that is needed to learn the dynamics of the world. Critics counter that pixel-level losses allocate model capacity by pixel mass and predictability rather than by causal relevance, so that the objects and contacts are precisely what the objective under-weights ( LeCun and others, 2022 ) . If correct, this is a failure mode that scaling alone will not efficiently resolve. The argument has motivated alternative, latent-predictive formulations ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) , but the effect it posits has not been measured directly.
blocks.zh: 最近的努力将世界模型扩大为大型和多样的人类-物体相互作用数据集(Punamiya等,2026年),有时包括数十年的相互作用-敏感镜头(Luo等,2026年;Dyna Robotics,2026年)。 随着数据和更大的模型的不断增加,鼓励了以规模为中心的观点:学习世界动态所需要的就是数据集和模型大小。 批评者反驳说,像素级损失通过像素质量和可预测性,而不是因果关联来分配模型容量,因此对象和接触正是目标重量不足(LeCun等,2022). 如果正确的话,这是一个失败模式,单靠缩放无法有效解决. 该论点激发了替代和潜在预测制剂(Assran等人,2023;Bardes等人,2024),但其假定的效果尚未被直接测量。

blocks.en: Testing that claim requires measuring interaction fidelity itself, across scale. Evidence for the scaling-centric view comes largely from downstream, task-level results: agreement between policy performance in learned and physics-based simulators ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , or offline action error when world models are used as policies ( Dyna Robotics, 2026 ) . Such evaluations compound errors across perception, agent motion, object dynamics, and policy behavior. We instead directly employ interaction-fidelity metrics ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ; Pallotta et al., 2026 ) , evaluating agent motion and its effect on the world separately as a function of training data, on a new out-of-distribution benchmark.
blocks.zh: 测试这一说法需要衡量互动的忠诚程度本身,在各个层面。 以缩放为中心的观点证据主要取自下游,任务层面的结果:在学习中的政策性能与基于物理的模拟器(Gao等,2026年)之间达成一致,或者在世界模型被用作政策时的离线行动错误(Dyna Robotics,2026年). 这种评价使各种认知、代理运动、物体动态和政策行为的错误复杂化。 相反,我们直接采用互动-可靠性衡量标准(Bagchi等,2026年;Pallotta等,2026年),作为培训数据的一项功能,评价代理人运动及其对世界的影响,评价新的分配基准。

blocks.en: Specifically, we train Cosmos 3 video world models ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) on nested subsets, from 300 to 30,000 hours, of a large and diverse corpus of ego-centric human manipulation spanning 32k tasks and 116 environment types, collected by 14k participants (see Section 3.2 for details). We repeat this sweep for three model variants and two action-conditioning designs, one of which supplies the agent’s body configuration as a projected skeleton ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wu and Gao, 2026 ) . All models are evaluated on an out-of-distribution benchmark with different capture hardware, sites, and participants, which we will release publicly.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们把宇宙3号视频世界模型(NVIDIA,2026)训练在由14克参与者收集的以自负为中心的大型和多样的人类操纵子集上,从300小时到30 000小时不等(详情见第3.2节)。 我们重复了这三款模型变体和两款动作空调设计,其中一款作为预测骨架供应了代理机身配置(Wang等,2025b;Wu和Gao,2026). 所有模型都以不同捕获硬件、网站和参与者的分布外基准进行评估,我们将公开发布。

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate that scaling ego-centric data improves both the agent and its action effects, but not equally. As shown in Figure 1 , agent fidelity climbs steadily toward usable levels while object fidelity lags far behind, improving more slowly and from a lower base. Better conditioning substitutes for most of the agent gains: 1k hours of skeleton-conditioned training exceed the agent fidelity that standard conditioning reaches at 30k, and both converge to nearly the same limit (Figure 4 , left). Saturating the agent this way isolates action effects and reveals that they converge far below the agent’s fidelity and far below the level that is usable for simulation (Figure 4 , right).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,以自我为中心的规模化数据既能改善物剂及其作用,又能提高作用,但不能同样提高作用。 如图1所示,物剂忠贞度稳步地向可用水平攀升,而物物忠贞度则远远落后,改善速度较慢,而且从较低的基数上看。 改善大多数制剂收益的替代条件: 1k小时的骨架条件训练超过了标准条件达到30k时的特质忠诚度,两者相会合到几乎相同的极限(图4,左出. 这样饱和剂会隔离出动作效果,并揭示出它们远低于剂的忠诚度,并远低于可用于模拟的水平(图4,右方)。

blocks.en:
Recently proposed interaction-focused objectives ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) do not change this. We introduce object-centric adaptive noise scheduling
(Section 5 ), which shifts supervision away from overall scene appearance and toward the dynamics of manipulated objects, and is the only intervention we test that raises the level object fidelity converges to. The improvement is nonetheless partial: object fidelity remains far below the agent’s, and closing the remaining gap will require more than data. Finally, we show that these gains transfer to a downstream humanoid setting (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
最近提出的注重互动的目标 (张等,2026b.)不改. 我们采用以物体为中心的适应性噪音排程
(第5节),它把监督从整个场景的外观转向被操纵物体的动态,是我们测试的唯一能提高物体忠诚度的干预措施。 然而,这种改进是局部的:物体的忠诚程度远远低于物剂的忠诚程度,缩小所剩差距需要的不仅仅是数据。 最后,我们表明,这些收益转移到下游的人体环境(第6节)。

blocks.en: We present a controlled study of how interaction fidelity in ego-centric world models behaves as a function of scale. Concretely: • We train Cosmos 3 world models on up to 30,000 hours of human–object interaction and find that agent fidelity and the fidelity of the agent’s effects on the world behave very differently under scale: the agent saturates early and is reached far more cheaply through conditioning than through data, while its effects converge far below it (Section 4 ). • We propose object-centric adaptive noise scheduling, which shifts the training signal from scene appearance toward the dynamics of manipulated objects. It is the only intervention we test that raises the level object fidelity converges to, though a substantial gap remains (Section 5 ). • We show that these gains transfer to a downstream humanoid setting, where our design contributes more than ego-centric pre-training alone does, but modeling humanoid’s interactions with the world remains a bottleneck (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出了关于自我中心世界模型中的相互作用忠贞性如何作为规模函数的受控研究。 具体地说: • 我们训练宇宙3号世界模型进行长达30,000小时的人类-物体相互作用,发现物剂忠贞性以及物剂对世界的影响忠贞性在规模下表现得非常不同:物剂早饱和,通过调节比通过数据得到的要便宜得多,而其作用远低于它(第4节)。 我们提出以物体为中心的适应性噪音排程,将训练信号从场景外观转向被操纵物体的动态. 这是我们检验的唯一一种能提高物体忠贞度的干预措施,尽管仍存在很大差距(第5节)。 我们显示,这些收益转移到下游人造物环境,我们的设计贡献大于仅仅以自我为中心的前期训练,但模拟人造物与世界的相互作用仍然是一个瓶颈(第6节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The idea that an agent can act by consulting an internal model of its environment dates to Craik (1943) , and was realized in neural controllers that predict future observations and plan through them ( Schmidhuber, 1990 ; Sutton, 1991 ) before being revived with modern architectures by Ha and Schmidhuber (2018) . In robotics, such models served as forward predictors in MPC, with actions selected by sampling candidate sequences
and scoring their outcomes ( Finn and Levine, 2017 ; Ebert et al., 2018 ) , or by optimizing policies within a learned latent space ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) . Their scope was limited to
fixed setups with a single embodiment and few objects, by the small scale of available robotics datasets ( Dasari et al., 2019 ) and by early generation
objectives ( Srivastava et al., 2015 ; Mathieu et al., 2016 ) that collapsed multi-modal futures toward a conditional mean and did not scale beyond low resolution and short horizons ( Villegas et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh:
一种观点认为一种剂可以通过咨询其环境的内部模型来行动到克赖克(1943年),并在预测未来观测并通过它们进行规划的神经控制器中被实现(Schmidhuber,1990年;Sutton,1991年)后被Ha和Schmidhuber用现代建筑复活. 在机器人学中,这种模型在MPC中充当了前向预测器,通过对候选序列进行抽样选择的动作.
并评分其成果(Finn and Levine, 2017;Ebert等人, 2018),或通过优化在所学潜在空间内的政策(Hafner等人, 2019;Hafner等人, 2023)。 其范围仅限于:
固定布局,由单一的浮雕和很少的物体,通过小规模的可得到的机器人数据集(Dasari等,2019年)和早期的生成.
目标(Srivastava等,2015年;Mathieu等,2016年)使多模式期货走向有条件的平面并不会超越低分辨率和短地平面(Villegas等,2019年)。

blocks.en:
Both limitations have since been addressed. Diffusion
models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) replaced regression with a sampling-based objective, and operating in a compressed latent space ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) with transformer backbones ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) made training on large datasets ( Chen et al., 2024 ) tractable, while coordinated collection efforts assembled robot interaction at a scale unavailable to earlier work ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ; Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) . This resulted in a new wave of
world models for robotics: IRASim ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) and Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) for tabletop manipulation, NWM ( Bar et al., 2025 ) and EgoWM ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ) for
ego-centric navigation and manipulation. What still bounds them is the data: teleoperation remains expensive, and the largest datasets cover only a few hundred scenes ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
这两种限制都得到了处理。 扩散
模型(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年;Ho等,2020年)用一个采样目标取代了回归,在压缩后的潜在空间运行(Rombach等,2022年)用变压器骨干(Peebles和Xie,2023年)使大型数据集(Chen等,2024年)的培训具有可引导性,而协调的收集工作则将机器人互动组合在一起,其规模无法用于早期的工作(O'Neill等,2024年;Khazatsky等,2024年)。 这导致了一个新的浪潮:
世界机器人模型: IRASim(Zhu等,2025年)和Ctrl-World(Guo等,2026年)用于桌面操纵,NWM(Bar等,2025年)和EgoWM(Bagchi等,2026年)用于台上操纵.
以自我为中心的导航和操纵 至今仍以数据为界:远程操作仍然昂贵,最大的数据集只覆盖了几百个场景(Khazatsky等,2024年).

blocks.en:
Ego-centric human video, in contrast, is abundant, diverse, requires no robot, and has driven a rapid scale-up of world-model pretraining. DreamDojo ( Gao et al., 2026 ) trains on 44k hours before post-training on small amounts of target robot data, reporting strong action
controllability across several humanoid embodiments; Being-H0.7 ( Luo et al., 2026 ) scales to 200k hours in a world-action formulation; and EgoScale ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) uses diverse ego-centric human data to improve dexterous manipulation. Industrial systems report pretraining
on larger datasets still ( Dyna Robotics, 2026 ) , with the prevailing conclusion that more human video yields better world models.
blocks.zh:
相形之下,以爱高为中心的人类视频是丰富多彩的,多样的,不需要机器人,并且带动了世界模型预训的快速推广. DreamDojo (Gao等, 2026年) 列车在训练后44k小时前进行小量目标机器人数据的训练,报告强力动作
(b) Ego Class (Zheng等,2026年)使用各种以自我为中心的人类数据来改进离心操纵。 工业系统报告预培训
(Dyna Robotics, 2026年), 普遍的结论是, 更多的人类视频产生更好的世界模型。

blocks.en:
These conclusions rest on aggregate measures, such as agreement between policy rankings computed in the model and in the real world ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) or action prediction accuracy ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Dyna Robotics, 2026 ) , which confirm practical utility but compound perception, dynamics, and control into a single number. Model quality itself is otherwise reported with metrics inherited from video generation: frame-level SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , PSNR ( Mannos and Sakrison, 1974 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) , or distributional FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) , which reward perceptual quality rather than accurate dynamics. None of these localize what improved.
Very recently, segmentation-based metrics that directly measure structural agreement between predicted and ground-truth videos have been proposed ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ; Pallotta et al., 2026 ) . We adopt this formulation, and report it separately for agents and objects being interacted with.
blocks.zh:
这些结论基于综合措施,例如模型中计算出的政策排名与现实世界之间的一致(Zhu等人,2025年;Guo等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年)或动作预测精度(Luo等人,2026年;Dyna Robotics,2026年),这证实了实用性但复合感知,动态,控制为单一数字. 模型质量本身则有从视频生成中继承的度量衡:帧级SSIM (Wang等,2004年),PSNR (Mannos and Sakrison,1974年),LPIPS (Zhang等,2018年)和DreamSim (Fu等,2023年),或分布式FVD (Unterthiner等,2018年),奖励知觉质量而非准确动态. 没有一个地方能把改善的都搞好
最近,有人提出了直接衡量预测视频和地面真实视频之间结构一致的分解度量(Bagchi等,2026;Pallotta等,2026)。 我们采用这种提法,并就与之相互作用的物剂和物品分别报告。

blocks.en: A parallel line of work questions whether pixel prediction is the right objective for world modeling at all. LeCun and others (2022) argues that predicting in observation space forces a model to allocate capacity to detail that is unpredictable and irrelevant to action, motivating joint-embedding architectures ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . If this critique is correct, capacity should flow to what dominates the frame and is easiest to predict (e.g. the background) rather than to the small, frequently occluded objects where the interaction actually happens. In this work, we test this hypothesis directly at scale.
blocks.zh: 一个平行的工作线质疑像素预测是否是世界建模的正确目标. LeCun等人(2022年)认为,在观测空间中预测一种模式,以分配能力来进行不可预测和与行动无关的细节,激发联合嵌入式建筑(Assran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年;Assran等人,2025年)。 如果这种批评是正确的,能力应该流向主导框架的东西,并且最容易预测(例如背景),而不是流向实际发生相互作用的经常被占用的小物体。 在这部作品中,我们直接以规模测试这个假设.

blocks.en:
Several approaches to improving agent and interaction fidelity have been proposed. On the agent side, skeleton-based conditioning has been explored ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wu and Gao, 2026 ) , motivated by cross-embodiment transferability, though its effect on scaling has not been examined. On the object side, earlier work proposed explicit object-centric representations ( Ferraro et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) , or auxiliary generation targets ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , however, those sacrifice the scalability of generic diffusion architectures and do not generalize to ego-centric video. PhysisForcing ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) adds trajectory and semantic alignment losses over physics-informative regions, but is evaluated on third-person robot manipulation with a fixed camera and largely unoccluded
interactions. We find it yields no improvement at scale in our setting, and propose an approach that does not rely on those conditions, raising the level object fidelity converges to.
blocks.zh:
提出了若干改进代理人和相互作用忠贞性的办法。 在代理人方面,已探索了骨架式的调节(Wang等,2025b; Wu and Gao, 2026 ),由交叉化可转移性所推动,虽然它对于缩放的影响尚未得到审查. 在物体方面,先前的工作提出了明确的以物体为中心的表示(Ferraro等,2025;Feng等,2025),或辅助生成目标(Yan等,2026),然而,这些牺牲了通用扩散架构的可扩展性,并没有概括到以自负为中心的视频. 物理强制 (Zhang等,2026b)在物理学信息化区域中增加了轨迹和语义相接损失,但通过固定相机对第三人称机器人操纵进行评价,基本未受干扰.

blocks.en:

Every frame carries calibrated intrinsics and a 6 6 -DoF camera pose, dense 3D hand keypoints (21 per hand)
and wrist poses, upper-body keypoints, and a free-form activity description. Crucially for studying generalization, the corpus is highly diverse: 116 environment categories (homes, bakeries, flower shops, farms, repair shops), 1,106 scene categories and 32,051 tasks from 14,019 participants, with no environment type exceeding 8.3 % 8.3\% of the data. blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价

blocks.en:
Because we ask whether generic models of object dynamics can be learned from ego-centric human video, we evaluate out of distribution. Our evaluation set comes from a separate recording campaign: none of its sessions appear in training, and since platform, operators and sites all differ, no location or participant is shared. 37 % 37\% of its environment categories, accounting for a quarter of its clips, never appear in training (Appendix F ). From this evaluation set we hand-curated 150 150 clips under three criteria: (i) non-trivial agent–object interaction — each clip contains active manipulation rather than idle or transit motion;
(ii) segmentable objects — the manipulated objects are large enough in
the image to be segmented accurately, which mask-based metrics rely on; and
(iii) accurate body-joint annotations — clips with accurate upper-body
and hand keypoints only.
blocks.zh:

只有手键。

Our key metrics are computed over the regions occupied by the hands and the manipulated objects rather than the full frame. We annotate every clip with SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) , prompting a few points on the first frame for the hands and each manipulated object and propagating them with the video tracker, then manually verify and correct the resulting tracks. The evaluation set
comprises 150 150 clips of 32 32 frames at 10 10 fps with 11,328 11{,}328 instance masks; models are evaluated on 17 17 -frame windows, one observed frame and 16 16 predicted. We will release the entire evaluation set.

We measure structural consistency and perceptual quality. SCS ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ) segments and tracks key scene elements through the predicted and ground-truth videos and averages mask IoU, capturing whether the provided actions are accurately reflected in the generated world. We
report it separately for the hands (agent) and the manipulated objects.
LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) serves as a perceptual control, so that differences in structural fidelity can be checked against differences in image quality.

blocks.en: Because mask tracking is itself imperfect, even a perfect prediction would not score an SCS of 1.0 1.0 . We estimate achievable maximum by re-initializing the tracker from different frames of the same video, with prompts sampled from the ground-truth masks, and measuring agreement between the resulting tracks: 0.93 for the agent and 0.90 for objects on ground-truth video, with comparable values on generated video, so the bound applies to model outputs too. Both lie well above the scores our models attain, so the differences we report reflect the models rather than the limits of the metric.
blocks.zh: 因为口罩跟踪本身是不完善的,即使一个完美的预测也不会得分为1.01.0的SCS. 我们通过从同一视频的不同帧重新启动追踪器,从地面真实口罩中抽取出提示,并测量所产生轨迹之间的一致,来估计可实现的最大限度:在地面真实的视频中,代理人0.93和物体0.90,在生成的视频中具有可比较的数值,所以约束也适用于模型输出。 两者都远远高于我们模型的得分,因此我们报告的差异反映了模型,而不是衡量尺度的限度。

blocks.en: 4 How Far Does Ego-centric Data Take Us?
blocks.zh: 4 如何远地以Ego为中心 数据拿我们?

blocks.en: We first ask what data volume alone provides, measuring directly how accurately the model renders the agent’s body and the objects it manipulates. Perceptual metrics are reported in Appendix C.2 as a control, confirming that the differences we measure are not confounded with image quality. The grey portion of the plots in Figure 4 shows agent and object fidelity as a function of pretraining data for Edge and Nano Cosmos 3 variants (dashed lines). Both improve across the full range, although the gap between modeling the agent and modeling its effect on the world grows with data scaling. Nano achieves both higher absolute fidelity and faster improvement than Edge, most visibly on objects ( + 0.14 +0.14 versus + 0.10 +0.10 ). Read at face value, this supports the scaling-centric view: fidelity rises with both data and model, suggesting continued scaling might eventually close the gap.
blocks.zh: 我们首先询问数据量本身能提供什么,直接测量模型如何精确地使代理人的身体及其操纵的对象。 概念度量衡在附录C.2中被报告为一种控制,确认我们衡量的差异并不与图像质量相混淆. 图4中的地块的灰色部分显示代理和对象忠诚度作为边缘和纳米宇宙3变体(dashed lines)预训数据的一个函数. 两者在全方位都有所改进,不过随着数据规模的扩大,模拟代理人和模拟其对世界的影响之间的差距也在扩大。 Nano既实现了更高的绝对忠诚度,也实现了比Edge更快的改进,在物体上最为明显(+0.14+0.14对+0.10+0.10). 以面值读取,这支持了以缩放为中心的观点:忠心随数据和模型同时上升,暗示继续缩放可能最终会缩小差距.

blocks.en: The two axes differ, however, in what the curves reveal about their limits. Agent fidelity is visibly saturating: it gains 0.12 SCS between 300 and 3k hours but only 0.06 between 3k and 30k, and fitting a saturating curve of the form S ∞ − c ​ D − α S_{\infty}-cD^{-\alpha} , standard in scaling-law analyses ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , places its asymptote at 0.811. Object fidelity shows no comparable deceleration, and a curve without curvature does not constrain its asymptote, so the object limit remains undetermined within our range, which is why we plot these curves only over the observed range. Rather than extending data collection by another order of magnitude, we next use skeleton conditioning as an instrument for locating that limit.
blocks.zh: 然而,在曲线揭示其界限方面,两轴是不同的。 物剂纯度明显饱和:在300至3k小时之间得到0.12 SCS,但在3k至30k之间只得到0.06分,并配有S-∞-c D-α S-_{\infty}-cD-^{--\-α}的饱和曲线,缩放法分析标准(Kaplan等,2020年;Hoffmann等,2022年),将其同位素分出0.811分. 对象忠诚度没有显示可比的减速,没有曲率的曲线不会约束它的同位素,所以物体的极限在我们的范围内仍然没有确定,这就是为什么我们只用所观察到的范围来绘制这些曲线的原因. 与其将数据收集工作扩大另一个数量级,我们接下来将使用骨架条件作为定位这一限值的工具。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Scaling reaches the agent’s limit, not the object’s. SCS for the agent (left) and manipulated objects (right) versus training data, with and without skeleton conditioning. Skeleton conditioning reaches the agent’s limit with far less data, while object fidelity converges far below.
blocks.zh: 图4: 放大达到代理的极限,而不是对象的极限。 用于代理(左)和被操纵对象(右)的SCS与训练数据相对,有和没有骨架调节. Skeleton 调制以少得多的数据达到代理的极限,而对象忠贞性则远低于此.

blocks.en: Skeleton conditioning supplies the agent’s projected body configuration in the camera frame, so the model no longer has to infer it from action tokens. The effect on the agent axis is large (solid curves in Figure 4 , left): with 300 hours, the skeleton-conditioned Nano variant reaches the agent fidelity the baseline attains only at roughly 15k hours - a ∼ \sim 50 × \times reduction in data - and gains just 0.06 SCS over the remaining two orders of magnitude. Crucially, conditioning changes when the agent’s limit is reached, not what it is: the two designs converge to about 0.01 SCS of one another (0.811 and 0.800). Additional ego-centric video therefore cannot meaningfully improve this axis, and saturating it early gives us an instrument for locating the object limit within our budget.
blocks.zh: 斯凯勒通调制在相机相框中供给了代理机的预测机身配置,因此模型不再需要从动作符中推断出. 对物剂轴的影响很大(图4中的固态曲线,左侧):由于300小时,骨架条件的纳米变体到达物剂忠心度,基线在大约15克时才达到——数据减少为\sim 50×分,超过其余两个数量级的增益仅为0.06SCS. 关键是,当剂的极限达到时,条件会发生变化,而不是是什么:两种设计相互汇合到大约0.01个SCS(0.811和0.800). 因此,更多的以自我为中心的视频无法有意义地改善这一轴线,并且提前饱和它给我们提供了一种在我们的预算内确定物体限制的工具。

blocks.en: Objects benefit from conditioning as well (Figure 4 , right), the Nano variant reaching at 300 hours the baseline’s fidelity at 3k, though this advantage narrows across the ladder. This could indicate a shortcut: by supplying body configuration directly, conditioning might spare the model visual inference that could support interaction modeling. We test this in Appendix C.1 by randomly dropping the skeleton during training, which retains that inference, and find no evidence of a shortcut. Conditioning therefore isolates the quantity we care about: with the agent held near its ceiling across the ladder, the object curve is largely unconfounded by improvements in agent fidelity.
blocks.zh: 纳诺变体在300小时时达到基线3克的忠诚度,但这一优势缩小了整个梯子。 这可能表示一种快捷方式:通过直接提供身体配置,调制可能会使模型视觉推断省去,从而可以支持交互建模. 在附录C.1中,我们通过在训练时随意放下骨架来检验这一点,这保留了这种推论,并且没有发现任何捷径的证据。 因此,附加条件隔离了我们所关心的数量:由于物剂在它的天花板上横跨了梯子,所以由于物剂忠诚度的提高,物体曲线基本上没有根据.

blocks.en: Measured this way, object fidelity improves by only 0.09 SCS across two orders of magnitude, and unlike the baseline it decelerates, gaining 0.056 between 300 and 3k hours but 0.035 between 3k and 30k. The curve is now in its saturating regime and its asymptote is identifiable: 0.565, of which the model has already realized 93% at 30k hours. Normalized by the maximum the metric can register for each category, the agent converges to 86% of its measurable range and objects to 63%. The limitation is therefore not that object dynamics improve slowly with data, but that the level they improve toward lies far below the agent’s.
blocks.zh: 以这种方式测量,物体的忠诚度在两个数量级之间只提高了0.09SCS,与基线不同,它减速了,在300至3k小时之间获得了0.056分,但在3k至30k之间获得了0.035分. 该曲线现在处于饱和状态,其不对称状态可以识别:0.565,其中模型在30克时已经实现93%. 以衡量标准的最大值为标准可以对每一类别进行登记,物剂合为可测量范围的86%,物体合为63%。 因此,限制不在于用数据来缓慢地改善物体动态,而是其改善程度远远低于物剂的水平。

blocks.en: Scaling the model size by a factor of 4 (Super variant shown in green) has virtually no effect on the agent fidelity, but raises the object ceiling by 0.034 SCS points. On one hand, this supports the scaling-centric view, suggesting that growing the model size together with the data could eventually bring interaction modeling fidelity to a usable level. Taken quantitatively, on the other hand, it does not. At 0.034 per quadrupling, closing the remaining 0.205 to the agent ceiling would require roughly 6 further quadruplings, some 4 orders of magnitude more parameters, with training compute rising in proportion. The estimate is a lower bound, since it assumes the per-quadrupling gain does not diminish. Neither axis we can scale therefore offers a practical route to closing this gap, so we turn to what the model is trained to predict.
blocks.zh: 将模型大小缩放因子为4(以绿色显示的超级变体),对物剂忠诚度几乎没有影响,但将物体上限提高了0.034 SCS分. 一方面,这支持了以缩放为中心的观点,表明将模型大小与数据相加,最终可以将模型忠实性的互动带到一个可用的水平. 另一方面,从数量上来看,情况并非如此。 按每四倍计算0.034美元计算,将剩余的0.205美元关闭在代理机上限上,将需要再增加大约6个四倍,即增加大约4个数量级参数,培训计算按比例增加。 估计值较低,因为它假定每平方公尺的增益不会减少。 因此,我们两个轴线都无法扩大规模,为缩小这一差距提供了一个实际途径,因此,我们转向模型所训练的预测。

blocks.en: 5 Can the object ceiling be moved?
blocks.zh: 页:1 物体天花板可以移动吗?

blocks.en: The previous section established a low limit on object fidelity that additional data is unlikely to overcome. We now ask whether changing the supervision can, using the Cosmos 3 Nano variant.
blocks.zh: 前一节对物体的忠诚度设定了低限,额外数据不可能被克服。 现在,我们想问一下,用宇宙3纳米变体,能否改变监管。

blocks.en:
PhysisForcing ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) localizes ‘physics-informative’ regions using 2D point tracking and monocular depth, then within them trains intermediate diffusion features to support point tracking against CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) references and aligns
their pairwise token-similarity matrix with a frozen V-JEPA 2
encoder ( Assran et al., 2025 ) . Re-implementing both objectives, we find they do not improve over the skeleton-conditioned baseline at 10k hours (Table 5 ). Both the localization heuristic and the tracking supervision rely on a static camera and largely unoccluded objects, and in ego-centric manipulation neither holds: the camera moves with the
agent, and the object is occluded by the very hand acting on it at the moment of contact. Next, we design an approach that depends on neither assumption.

We first report an ablation of different components of our objective at 10k hours in Table 5 . Reweighting alone does not meaningfully improve fidelity, whereas raising the noise level does,
and is the only intervention we test that improves object fidelity. Replacing M dyn M^{\mathrm{dyn}} with randomly placed regions of the same extent removes nearly all of the gain, confirming that the benefit comes from where supervision is shifted rather than from the perturbation itself. Reweighting adds a small further improvement at no extra cost, so we include it in our final configuration. blocks.en: Figure 5 reports object interaction fidelity across the data ladder. Our method exceeds the skeleton baseline at every budget, reaching 0.546 against 0.527 at 30k hours (improvement of 3.7%), and fitting the same saturating form places its asymptote above the baseline’s. The gain is, however, roughly constant across budgets: the ceiling is raised, not the rate at which it is approached, and it remains far below the agent’s. Improving interaction fidelity to a usable level will require more substantial changes to how world models are trained.
blocks.zh: 图5报告横跨数据阶梯的物体相互作用忠贞性。 我们的方法超过了每个预算的骨架基线,在30克时达到0.546比0.527(改善3.7 % ) , 并安装同样的饱和形式,使得它的不对称度高于基线。 然而,各预算的收益大致保持不变:上限提高,而不是接近上限的速度,而且远远低于代理人的水平。 将互动忠实提升到可使用的水平,需要更加实质性地改变世界模式的培训方式。

blocks.en: 6 Transfer to humanoids
blocks.zh: 6 转让给人体

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Cosmos 3 Nano on ground-truth demonstrations from 11 tasks from the simulated bimanual benchmark of Yang et al. (2025) , conditioning on a single start frame and the 138-dimensional humanoid state trajectory and predicting the following 16 frames (17 total at 10 Hz). We compare three variants sharing the same recipe and evaluation clips: Cosmos 3 , from the released weights, which have never seen our ego-centric data; +Human , from the matched checkpoint pre-trained on 30,000 h without skeleton conditioning or our supervision scheme;
and Ours , from the checkpoint pre-trained with both, which remain active during fine-tuning. The first pair isolates ego-centric human pre-training, the second our design. All evaluations are performed on EgoVLA policy rollouts rather than demonstrations. Further details provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
我们根据杨等模拟双人基准的11项任务,对宇宙3纳诺进行地面真实演示。 (2025年),以单一起落架和138维人形状态轨迹为条件并预测了以下16个起落架(共17个起落架为10赫兹). 我们比较了三个共享相同食谱和评价剪辑的变体:Cosmos 3,来自释放的重量,它们从未见过我们以自我为中心的数据;+Human,来自匹配的检查站,在30,000 h上进行预先训练,没有骨架调节或我们的监督计划;
和我们的,从检查站 预先训练与两者, 在微调期间仍然活跃。 第一对隔离以自我为中心的人类预训 第二对我们的设计 所有评价都是在 " EgoVLA " 政策推广方面而不是在示范方面进行的。 附录E提供了进一步详情。

blocks.en:
We report SCS for hands and manipulated objects separately, using manually verified masks. To assess applicability to downstream robotics evaluation, we additionally measure how well each model’s rendered rollouts support the same success judgment as the simulator’s: within each rollout we locate the 17-frame window in which the outcome is decided, replay its actions through each variant, and apply the benchmark’s success criterion to both renderings, reporting
how often the two verdicts agree. Restricting to the critical window isolates world-model fidelity from drift over long rollouts. Appendix E gives the full protocol, and per-task results.
blocks.zh:
我们使用人工验证的口罩,分别报告手和被操纵物体的SCS. 为了评估对下游机器人评估的适用性,我们进一步衡量每个模型的推出在多大程度上支持了与模拟模型相同的成功判断:在每次推出过程中,我们确定决定结果的17个框架窗口,通过每个变体重现其行动,并将基准成功标准应用于两种渲染,报告
两次判决多频繁地达成一致. 限制在关键窗口 将世界模式的忠诚 与漂移 长期推出。 附 录 E给出了完整的协议,以及每个任务的结果.

blocks.en:
Ego-centric human pre-training transfers, improving every measure and most clearly hand SCS ( + 0.07 +0.07 , Table 2 ). Our conditioning and supervision design contributes more than twice as much on top of it. The pattern matches our human-video findings in one respect and departs from it in another. As there, gains are larger for the agent than for the objects it manipulates ( + 0.17 +0.17 versus + 0.06 +0.06 ). Unlike there, object fidelity is high in
absolute terms for every variant ( 0.70 0.70 – 0.79 0.79 ), which we attribute to the simulated environment: its objects are rigid and relatively large, so the conditions that make object dynamics hard in ego-centric human video are largely absent. Conclusions about interaction fidelity thus depend heavily on the difficulty of the evaluation setting.
blocks.zh:
以Ego为中心进行人类预训转移,改进了每一项测量,最明显的是手接SCS(+0.07+0.07,表2. 我们的调制和监督设计对它的贡献是它的两倍多。 这种模式与我们人类-视频在某一方面的调查结果相匹配,在另一方面则偏离。 因此,代理人的收益大于其操纵的物体的收益(+0.17+0.17对+0.06+0.06)。 和那里不同,物体的忠诚度很高
每个变体的绝对名词(0.70 0.70 – 0.79 0.79),我们将此归属于模拟环境:它的物体是刚性而相对大的,因此在以自我为中心的人类视频中使物体动态硬化的条件基本不存在. 因此,关于互动忠实的结论在很大程度上取决于评价设置的困难。

blocks.en: Success agreement follows the same ordering with smaller margins, and is less diagnostic: a single number records that agreement differed without indicating where. SCS localizes the residual error to the objects. Over the prediction horizon, hand SCS for Ours is nearly flat, falling from 0.89 at frame 2 to 0.85 at frame 16, while object SCS falls more than twice as far, from 0.82 to 0.71. The model knows where the hands will be, but fails to correctly predict the consequences of agent’s actions in the world. We illustrate this via qualitative analysis in Appendix B.2 .

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Our results are not an argument against collecting ego-centric human video: more data improved both axes at every scale we measured, and pre-training transferred to humanoids. They are an argument against expecting collection alone to close the interaction gap. Agent fidelity approaches its limit well before 30k hours, while the fidelity of the agent’s effects on the world converges far below it, even with our supervision scheme.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果并不是反对收集以自我为中心的人类视频的论据:更多的数据改进了我们所测量的每个尺度的轴心,以及将预训转移到人造物上。 他们反对只期望收集来缩小互动差距。 代理人忠诚度在30克小时前接近极限,而代理人对世界的影响的忠诚度远低于它,甚至与我们的监督计划相会合。

blocks.en:
Two factors plausibly contribute (see Appendix B.1 for qualitative analysis). The first is irreducible uncertainty: how an object responds to contact depends on mass, friction and stiffness, none of which is perfectly recoverable from a single frame. The second is that the quantities that matter most are not observable in pixels at all. An object’s geometry is only partially visible, and the parts most relevant to an interaction (those under the hand, at the point of contact) are exactly the parts the hand occludes. Contacts and forces are never visible. These are precisely what a physics simulator represents exactly
and can supply as supervision, while remaining poor at the complex dynamics that motivated learned world models in the first place. Each paradigm is strongest where the other is weakest, and recent work distilling simulators into differentiable generative 3D particle models ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Duisterhof et al., 2026 ) suggests a path to combining them.
blocks.zh:
有两个因素可以合理地发挥作用(定性分析见附录B.1)。 第一种是不可减少的不确定性:物体如何对接触作出反应取决于质量,摩擦和僵硬性,其中没有一个是完全可以从一个框架中恢复的. 第二是,在像素中,最重要的数量根本无法观测到。 物体的几何只是部分可见的,而与一相互作用最相干的部分(手下,接触点上)正是手所吞噬的部分. 接触和力量永远看不到。 这些正是物理模拟器代表的
并且可以提供作为监督,同时在促使学习世界模式的复杂动态方面表现不佳。 在对方最弱的地方,每个范式都最强,而近期将模拟器分馏成可分泌的基因3D粒子模型的工作(Wang等,2025a;Duisterhof等,2026),则暗示了结合它们的途径.

blocks.en:
Our data ladder spans two orders of magnitude and couples data volume with optimization budget. It therefore establishes where fidelity is heading under joint scaling, not the effect of either factor alone.
However, because the smaller budgets receive proportionally fewer optimization steps, they are further from convergence than the larger ones, and training each to convergence would raise the left of the curve more than the right and therefore lower the fitted asymptote. The ceilings we report are in this sense optimistic. They also hold only insofar as the fitted regime continues beyond 30k hours. Despite their diversity, both our training and evaluation sets come from a single collection protocol, and the evaluation set is limited in scale, which constrains how far our conclusions generalize to ego-centric video as a whole. Finally, our experiments study generative world models. Whether latent-predictive models learn to capture interaction dynamics more readily remains open, and cannot be settled with our fidelity metrics as those models do not render pixels.
blocks.zh:
我们的数据阶梯跨越两个数量级和夫妇数据量,并优化预算。 因此,它确定忠诚属于联合规模,而不仅仅是两个因素的影响。
然而,由于较小的预算得到的优化步骤按比例较少,因此它们比较大的更接近于趋同步骤,而且每次培训到趋同将使曲线左侧比右侧更高,从而降低所安装的同位素. 我们报告的上限在这个意义上是乐观的。 它们也只维持30小时以上。 尽管我们的培训和评价集多种多样,但它们都来自单一的收集协议,而评价集的规模有限,这制约了我们的结论对以自我为中心的整个视频的概括程度。 最后,我们的实验研究基因世界模型。 潜在预测模型是否学会更方便地捕捉相互作用动力学,是否仍然开放,无法用我们的忠诚度度量表来解决,因为这些模型不会产生像素。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows an example of improvement of our model over vanilla Cosmos 3 (top) and four remaining failure modes (bottom). Though our method improves the agent fidelity and some aspects of object interaction, as illustrated by the package handling sample, we still observe several failure modes. Specifically, contact modeling remains challenging, as illustrated by spoon example, where only one of the two objects is moved by the agent’s right hand. The model also struggles with identifying physical properties of the objects from RGB frames, as shown on the example of the rigid board being interpreted as stretchable. In addition, object permanence and non-rigid object dynamics modeling remain a challenge, as can be seen from the disappearing cucumber sample and incorrect paper folding dynamics. More examples are provided on the project website , where they are also best viewed in a video form.

blocks.en: C.1 Skeleton Dropout Ablation
blocks.zh: C.1 斯凯利通辍学

blocks.en: We test whether always supplying the projected skeleton limits object interaction learning by reducing the model’s reliance on visual inference. We compare Cosmos 3 Nano with standard skeleton conditioning against a variant trained with skeleton dropout. For each training clip, we independently set the entire encoded skeleton sequence to zero with probability 0.25 0.25 , after the frozen VAE and before the learned projection. A single dropout decision applies to all frames and spatial locations in the clip. This intervention leaves the action tokens, observed RGB frame, and video targets unchanged. Both variants receive the full skeleton sequence during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过降低模型对视觉推论的依赖来测试是否总是提供预测的骨架来限制物体的相互作用学习. 我们比较了Cosmos 3 Nano 与标准骨架调节 与一个训练有素的 骨架辍学的变体。 对于每一个训练片段,我们独立地将整个被编码的骨架序列设定为0,概率为0.250.25,在被冻结的VAE之后和被学习到的投影之前. 单一的退学决定适用于剪辑中的所有帧和空间位置. 这种干预留下了动作符号,观察到了RGB帧,视频目标不变. 两个变体在评价过程中都得到完整的骨架序列.

blocks.en: We compare checkpoints at 10k training hours, with the same pretrained initialization, training-data schedule, global batch size of 512, and optimizer settings. Both runs use standard denoising supervision without our dynamic-region modifications.

The results indicate that skeleton conditioning does not introduce shortcuts for learning object interaction dynamics.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , the random dropout shows no meaningful effect on agent fidelity and marginally lowers object fidelity. At the matched 10k-hour budget, we therefore observe no scaling benefits from it, lifting the potential concerns of a learning shortcut introduced by skeleton conditioning.

The humanoid state space is 138-dimensional against the pre-trained checkpoints’ 160, so we
re-initialize the action projection and leave the rest of the model unchanged. All three
variants are fine-tuned on ground-truth demonstrations from the same 11 tasks with the hyperparameters of Section G , with a global batch size of 64. For Ours , skeleton conditioning and dynamic-region supervision remain active during fine-tuning, with the skeleton obtained from the humanoid’s forward kinematics.

blocks.en: SCS is measured on the benchmark’s validation split. Hand masks come from SAM2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) prompted at frame 0 with 18 forward-kinematics-projected links per hand and then tracked; object masks come from SAM3 with a per-task text prompt. All masks were manually verified. Success agreement is measured on a separate set of hand-curated windows, so the two measures agree on the ordering of the variants while being computed over different clips.
blocks.zh: SCS是通过基准的验证分拆来测量的. 手口罩出自SAM2(Ravi等,2025年),在帧0被催出,每只手有18个前缘预测链接并被跟踪;物体口罩出自SAM3,每任务文字提示. 所有口罩都经过人工核实。 成功协议是在一套单独的手工加工窗口上衡量的,因此,两项措施在通过不同片段计算的同时,商定变种的顺序。

blocks.en:
Each variant is reported at its best checkpoint within a capped window rather than over its whole run, because the three converge at very different rates
(Table 6 ): both ego-centrically pre-trained variants are at their plateau by iteration 2,000, while Cosmos 3 gains 0.19 hand SCS between 2,000 and 9,000 on trained tasks against 0.003 for Ours . Reading the comparison at a single early iteration
would therefore measure convergence rate rather than the effect of pre-training. We cap Ours and +Human at 3,000 and Cosmos 3 at 9,000. Selecting on the clips we report is optimistic in absolute terms, but it is applied identically to all three variants; at fixed iterations the two pre-trained variants differ from their selected values by at most 0.005 SCS.

blocks.en: From each EgoVLA rollout we extract the 17 frames in which the task outcome is decided, e.g. the moment an object is released, a target is reached, or the simulator records success. We replay that clip’s actions through each variant and render the prediction. A reviewer then records a success or fail verdict from the rendered clip, once for the simulator’s rendering and once for each variant’s prediction, applying the benchmark’s criterion in both cases, and we report how often the two verdicts agree.
blocks.zh: 从每次EgoVLA的推出中,我们提取了决定任务结果的17个框架,例如一个对象被放出,目标被达到,或者模拟器记录成功. 我们通过每个变体来重放剪辑的动作,并作出预测。 然后,一个审查员记录了从所提供剪辑中得出的成败判断,一次用于模拟器的渲染,一次用于每个变体的预测,在两种情况下都适用基准标准,我们报告两种判决的一致程度。

blocks.en: The verdict is therefore about the window, not the episode. This matters because a 17-frame window covers a single interaction event, so a failed episode can contain a cleanly executed sub-task and a successful one a failure. Using the simulator’s episode-level flag as the reference would mislabel a substantial fraction of windows. We use that flag only to stratify which clips are reviewed, so the reviewed subset is not skewed toward whichever outcome dominates a task.
blocks.zh: 因此判决涉及的是窗口,而不是剧集. 这一点很重要,因为17帧窗口覆盖了单一的交互事件,所以失败的一集可以包含一个干净地执行的子任务,而成功的一集则是失败. 使用模拟器的插图级别旗作为参考会误贴一大部分窗口的标签. 我们只用这面旗子来划分哪些片段经过审查,因此,经过审查的片段不会向主导某项任务的哪一个结果倾斜。

blocks.en: Seven of the eleven tasks have such a decisive moment: Close-Drawer , Insert-Cans , Open-Laptop , Pour-Balls , Push-Box , Sort-Cans and Stack-Can . In the other four the outcome unfolds over more frames than the clip contains like in Open-Drawer and Unload-Cans ; or the success conditions defined in the simulator are too lenient like in Flip-Mug . Therefore we exclude these tasks from our evaluation. The review covers six clips per task, 42 in total, with one reviewer and one seed per variant (detailed breakdown provided in Table 8 ).

blocks.en:
Our evaluation sequences are captured with a multi-camera stereo platform, whereas our training dataset is monocular. We use the stereo left camera for evaluation, however, it is delivered as a double-sphere fisheye. To match the training set sensor, for each frame we unproject the target 908 × 512 908{\times}512 pinhole pixels to rays and reproject them through the double-sphere model, resampling the source
image (Fig. 13 ); the intrinsics are held fixed across all
clips. This yields a pinhole camera model consistent with the training data,
isolating content/appearance domain shift from any lens-model mismatch.
